channel.title: Gportal incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Gportal's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Increased packet loss in US West, Oceania, and International regions [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. Thank you for your patience!

item.title: Partial outage affecting game servers in US East [resolved]
item.description: All game servers in the US East region are back online and working normally. The issue has been fully resolved. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Partial US Website Outage [resolved]
item.description:
This incident is now resolved. The US website, Minecraft, and all other services are fully operational and reachable as usual.
Thank you for your patience during the disruption. If you still notice any issues, please reach out to our support team.

item.title: Network Connectivity Issues — Taipei [resolved]
item.description: After reviewing our infrastructure, we can confidently say that the issue is resolved

item.title: Power outage at our Washington (US East) datacenter [resolved]
Website Timeouts and Login Issues [resolved]
item.description:
The issue has been fully resolved and all affected services are operating normally again.
Website performance and login functionality have returned to normal, and we are no longer seeing elevated error rates or timeouts. Throughout the incident, game servers remained fully operational and were not affected.
We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience while we worked to resolve the issue.

item.title: Website currently unavailable [resolved]
item.description:
This issue is now fully resolved and our website is operating normally.
We've confirmed that everything is stable. We've deployed a fix and added safeguards to prevent it from recurring. Your game servers were not affected at any point.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.

item.title: Website and account settings unavailable [resolved]
item.description:
This incident has been resolved. Access to our website and account settings has been fully restored, and everything is looking healthy and stable again.
Our game server panel and the game servers themselves were not affected at any point.
Thanks for your patience, and we apologise for any inconvenience.

item.title: Slow website loading [resolved]
item.description: We've kept an eye on things since the fix went out, and everything's been running smoothly. The issue is now fully resolved — thanks again for your patience!

item.title: Web interface issues affecting some games [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting access to certain game servers via the web interface has been resolved. All affected customers should now be able to access and manage their servers as normal.
Throughout the incident, running game servers were not impacted. Thank you for your patience.
